arcades.info_text: Formerly Free Play Arlington. / Tokyo Station has two primary game zones: / Free Play Tokyo: Purchase an optional $11 day-pass wristband and gain access 55+ Japanese imports all set to our favorite game setting of all time: “Free Play”. This zone is built for exploration and features: (1) an ever-changing selection of Japanese fighters, puzzle games, and more in classic Japanese “candy” arcade cabinets, (2) a curated selection of the most sought after Japanese rhythm games, (3) imported racing games, (4) a selection of Japanese releases in their classic American wooden cabs (think Galaga), and (5) revolving bonus arcade content. / Tokyo Station: You’re not in Tokyo if your arcade doesn’t have an incredible selection of prized skill games! Expect a massive selection of custom claw games featuring the most authentic Japanese prize selection available in the USA along with a wall of imported Gachapon from the largest independent importer of Japanese capsule toys (that’s us!) In this area, you’ll also find a variety of amusements that work best outside of the “Free Play” section, such as Pop-A-Shot, Pinball, and more!
